body.purpose: Page default and honest empty/error paragraphs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ivory filled ops/gate primary for sign-in, create board, and add numbers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); color: var(--ink, #10181a); border: 1px solid var(--ivory, #eff0f0); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Ghost destructive control. Fault-red type; seam appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: var(--danger, #d35a4a); border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 8px 12px; margin-left: 24px; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { border-color: var(--danger, #d35a4a); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Map Key
components.description: Seamed map tool for zoom and reset. Seam turns ivory on hover.
components.css: .ds-map-tools { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-map-key { min-width: 28px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-key:hover, .ds-map-key:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); } .ds-map-key:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Console Input
components.description: Void-well field with amber caret. Used on login and ops forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); } .ds-input { padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; background: var(--ink-2, #0a0c0f); color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--amber, #e3b341); font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ops Frame
components.description: Seamed 18px ops form/list frame on Admin and Tracker.
components.html: Create company
components.css: .ds-ops-form { border: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); padding: 18px; background: var(--ink, #10181a); color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-ops-title { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-ops-form .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); } .ds-ops-form .ds-input { padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; background: var(--ink-2, #0a0c0f); color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--amber, #e3b341); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; } .ds-ops-form .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ops-form .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); color: var(--ink, #10181a); border: 1px solid var(--ivory, #eff0f0); padding: 10px 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ops-form .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-ops-form .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-ident { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 18px; background: var(--ink, #10181a); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); } .ds-ident-left { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; } .ds-wordmark { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); } .ds-pipe { color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-live-label { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-fetch { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); } .ds-pip { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live, #3ddc84); }

components.name: Shipment Row
components.description: List button. Active row wells and carries a 6px amber pip; live status is amber.
components.css: .ds-ship-row { display: grid; position: relative; width: 100%; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 16px 10px 22px; background: transparent; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); text-align: left; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ship-row:hover, .ds-ship-row:focus-visible { background: var(--row-hover, #141c1e); } .ds-ship-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e3b341); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ship-row.is-active { background: var(--row-active, #161f22); } .ds-ship-row.is-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 16px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber, #e3b341); } .ds-ship-num { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--amber, #e3b341); } .ds-ship-lane, .ds-ship-status { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); } .ds-ship-status { justify-self: end; }

components.css: .ds-history { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ivory, #eff0f0); } .ds-history li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr; gap: 10px; position: relative; padding: 0 0 14px; } .ds-history li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 5px; top: 8px; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--seam, #373e3d); } .ds-history li:last-child::before { display: none; } .ds-node { width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-top: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #10181a); } .ds-history .is-current .ds-node { border-color: var(--amber, #e3b341); background: var(--amber, #e3b341); } .ds-history p { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-place { color: var(--ivory-dim, #c0c1c1); }

components.name: Flash
components.description: Seamed status strip. Fault red for errors, signal green for success.
components.css: .ds-flash { border: 1px solid var(--seam, #373e3d); padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: Iosevka, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: var(--ink, #10181a); } .ds-flash-bad { color: var(--danger, #d35a4a); } .ds-flash-ok { color: var(--live, #3ddc84); }

narrative.overview:
Live Board is a dark-first operator console for company-scoped FedEx tracking. The public page is a tiled night instrument: ident, shipment list, map, facts, and history occupy one viewport. Selecting a tracking number swaps panel contents in place. It does not restyle the grid, and it does not introduce a marketing hero.

The shipped ground is cooler and darker than the original challenger brief. Graphite night fills the frame; ivory type and 1px oxide seams do the structure; syntax amber is reserved for live state. One face, Iosevka, carries wordmark, data, and labels. Admin, Tracker, and login inherit the same night, with ivory filled primaries for irreversible ops.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport tiled console (list / map / facts / history), not stacked cards
Graphite ground, ivory type, 1px seams, square corners
Iosevka throughout; uppercase tracking labels with wide letter-spacing
Honest empty and error copy — never a fabricated delivery

rules.name: The Live Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks live state only: in-transit status, the selected pip, the current history node, the map course, caret, selection, and focus. It is not a brand fill, not a primary button, and not a decorative highlight.

rules.name: The Honest Empty Rule
rules.body: Missing credentials, queued numbers, and empty history say so in dim ivory. Never paint a delivered package, a fake route, or invented FedEx copy.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Iosevka is the only type family. Do not pair it with a humanist sans, a serif display, or system UI for chrome.

rules.name: The Tracking Label Rule
rules.body: Console chrome and field labels are uppercase with wide tracking (0.16em–0.22em). Sentence-case is for honest empty/error paragraphs only.

rules.name: The Tile Persistence Rule
rules.body: List, map, facts, and history persist. Selection swaps contents in place; it never restacks the console into a hero, a single card, or a wizard.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Partition with 1px {colors.seam}. Do not lift panels with shadows, glass, or gradients.

dos: Do keep the four tiles (list, map, facts, history) on the public board and change contents on selection.
Do use syntax amber only for live/in-transit/selected/focus/caret/selection.
Do set ops and gate primaries in console ivory on graphite night.
Do partition with 1px seam oxide; keep corners at 0px.
Do write empty, queued, missing-key, and error states in dim ivory as facts (`AWAITING FEDEX`, `QUEUED`, `Board not found`).
Do set `:focus-visible` to a 1px amber outline with 2px offset.
donts: Don't introduce a marketing hero, testimonial, or carrier-branded banner on any surface.
Don't invent FedEx statuses, ETAs, routes, or delivered packages when the API has not returned them.
Don't fill primary actions in amber or green — those colors are status, not buttons.
Don't add drop shadows, large radius, or a second type family.
Don't restyle Admin / Tracker / login into a light dashboard; they inherit the Night Console.
